title: Local review and closeout cells still route role jobs on the claude CLI
body:
The common runners.toml's [roles.review] and [roles.closeout] cells name kind = "claude", and runners.local.toml declares no override for either role cell, so a local run (herdr or harness) dispatches review-epic and closeout-epic — role jobs, at their base values, no tier — on the claude CLI. The operator's 2026-10-04 decision keeps the claude CLI 'for the frontier tier only' and says 'every other local and all cloud workers run on pi-durable'; strictly read, the role cells are outside the frontier-rung exception. It may be intended (the file's own Phase-2 comments reserve opus 'for review and closeout'), so it needs an explicit operator routing decision before the final review scores A1: either bless the cells as part of the exception, or re-route them to pi and extend the 7ml guard from the implement role to every role.
evidence: .tick/runners.toml [roles.review] and [roles.closeout] (kind = "claude", model = "opus"); .tick/runners.local.toml declares no [roles.review]/[roles.closeout]; internal/reconcile/profiles.go derivableTiersFor: a role job without a policy route runs at base values
